CwdChanged.desc: Fires when the working directory changes.
CwdChanged.label: Directory changed

DirectoryAdded.desc: Fires when a directory is added to the session workspace.
DirectoryAdded.label: Directory added

Elicitation.desc: Fires when the agent prompts you for structured input.
Elicitation.label: Elicitation

ElicitationResult.desc: Fires once you answer an elicitation prompt.
ElicitationResult.label: Elicitation result

FileChanged.desc: Fires when a watched file changes on disk.
FileChanged.label: File changed

InstructionsLoaded.desc: Fires when CLAUDE.md / instructions are loaded.
InstructionsLoaded.label: Instructions loaded

MessageDisplay.desc: Fires when the runtime displays a message to the user.
MessageDisplay.label: Message displayed

Notification.desc: Fires on a runtime notification (idle, awaiting input).
Notification.label: Notification

PermissionDenied.desc: Fires when a permission request is denied.
PermissionDenied.label: Permission denied

PermissionRequest.desc: Fires when a tool asks for permission; can auto-decide.
PermissionRequest.label: Permission request

PostCompact.desc: Fires after the context window is compacted.
PostCompact.label: After compaction

PostToolBatch.desc: Fires once after a batch of parallel tool calls completes.
PostToolBatch.label: After tool batch

PostToolUse.desc: Fires after a tool returns; inspect or annotate the result.
PostToolUse.label: After tool

PostToolUseFailure.desc: Fires when a tool call errors out.
PostToolUseFailure.label: After tool failure

PreCompact.desc: Fires before the context window is compacted.
PreCompact.label: Before compaction

PreToolUse.desc: Fires before a tool runs; a hook can block or rewrite the call.
PreToolUse.label: Before tool

SessionEnd.desc: Fires when a session ends; run cleanup or logging.
SessionEnd.label: Session end

SessionStart.desc: Fires when a session begins; good for injecting standing context.
SessionStart.label: Session start

Setup.desc: Fires while a repository or worktree environment is being set up.
Setup.label: Setup

Stop.desc: Fires when the assistant finishes its turn.
Stop.label: Stop

StopFailure.desc: Fires when a turn ends because of an error.
StopFailure.label: Stop (failed)

SubagentStart.desc: Fires when a native subagent begins its run.
SubagentStart.label: Subagent start

SubagentStop.desc: Fires when a subagent finishes its run.
SubagentStop.label: Subagent stop

TaskCompleted.desc: Fires when an agent task completes.
TaskCompleted.label: Task completed

TaskCreated.desc: Fires when an agent task is created.
TaskCreated.label: Task created

TeammateIdle.desc: Fires when an agent-team member goes idle.
TeammateIdle.label: Teammate idle

UserPromptExpansion.desc: Fires while a prompt's macros are expanded.
UserPromptExpansion.label: Prompt expansion

UserPromptSubmit.desc: Fires when you send a prompt; can inject context or block it.
UserPromptSubmit.label: Prompt submitted

WorktreeCreate.desc: Fires when a git worktree is created.
WorktreeCreate.label: Worktree created

WorktreeRemove.desc: Fires when a git worktree is removed.
WorktreeRemove.label: Worktree removed
